title: Customer Invoice report shows a line as Title - Description - Tech story
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure Require Tech Story is on (Settings, then the Work Orders tab).
  • Create a work order for this test, work order 1, with one labor line, line 1, titled "Replace tie rod" with the description "excessive play".
  • Have line 1 completed with the tech story "Both outer ends worn, replaced and aligned", and work order 1 completed and invoiced today as invoice A.
  • Use Google Sheets (File, then Import, then Upload) to open downloaded files, so accented letters and character counts read correctly.
  • Start on Reports, then Export Reports in the Reports left menu, with the Export Report dialog open.
custom_steps:
1. Pick Customer Invoice in the Report Name list.
  2. Set the date range to today.
  3. Click Download.
  4. Open the downloaded file in Google Sheets.
  5. In an empty cell, enter =LEN() with line 1's ItemDescription cell inside the brackets.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Customer Invoice is picked in Report Name.

Step 2:

  • The date range shows today's date.

Step 3:

  • A Customer Invoice file downloads.

Step 4:

  • In line 1's row (work order 1's invoice A) the ItemDescription cell reads exactly "Replace tie rod - excessive play - Both outer ends worn, replaced and aligned".
  • The cell has none of our field names: no "What are you doing?:", "Why are you doing it?:", "Title:", "Description:" or "Tech Story:", and no semicolon.
  • Each join between two parts is exactly one space, one hyphen, one space: no double space and no other kind of dash.

Step 5:

  • The cell shows 77 (15 + 3 + 14 + 3 + 42 = 77), so nothing is added and nothing trails after the last word.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "What Are You Doing / Why Are You Doing It?" (Title and Description), Confluence 845348896, version 15 (14 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11257, story SV-10132 (Story 3, What Reaches QuickBooks)

  • S3-R1: “A line's text joins the title, the description and the technician's narrative with a spaced hyphen and no labels: "Replace tie rod - excessive play - Both outer ends worn, replaced and aligned".”
  • S3-R2: “The separator is exactly one space, one hyphen-minus, one space.”
  • S3-R5: “The technician's narrative is the third and last segment. It carries no label of any kind, and no semicolon appears anywhere in the line text. The reasoning is in §2.”
  • S3-R6a: “A narrative is absent legitimately, not only exceptionally. The organization setting Administration, Work Order Settings, Require Tech Story governs whether the completion gate gets in the way, so a shop with it switched off invoices completed lines with no narrative as a matter of course. Shops created since the setting was introduced (June 2025) start with it off; shops that existed then started with it on. Each shop keeps the value it has set, and this change does not touch it.”
  • Key Decisions: “The line text carries no labels for any of the three values. It reads "{Title} - {Description} - {Tech story}", for example "Replace tie rod - excessive play - Both outer ends worn, replaced and aligned". The goal is that a shop's accounting records read the way our own invoice reads, and our invoice prints all three with no field names in front of them. Rejected: keeping shortened labels, "Title: ...;Description: ...;Tech Story: ...". It is an improvement on the questions, and the Batch 1 branch first built it, but it still prints our field names into someone else's books, which is the actual complaint. That build never reached develop or a release.”

Not yet checked against a build by us: the QA build (sv10130.qa.shopview.com, QuickBooks host qb1.qa.shopview.com) and staging carry this change, and this case has not been run on either.
